policy.baseline_status: All LOCKED until audited. Existing maturity evidence is NOT automatically mapped to achievement unlocks.
policy.symbolic: All active achievements unlocked signifies substantial maturity against current scope, but never automatically gives project 100% or overrides release gates.
policy.dynamic: Changes to status/title/criteria and create/retire require evidence and append-only change log. Local browser edits are drafts until exported and committed in Git.
policy.retirement: Soft-retire with tombstone; never reuse IDs; revised versions retain previous records in audit log.
policy.unlock: Unlock only with objective criteria, verifier, at least one evidence link, and all named prerequisites unlocked. No automated fake unlock.
policy.scoring: Achievement completion is count(unlocked active)/count(active) and separate from contractual V4 36.90%, CT2, VSDS and 0/6 gates.
